description: Batch text classifier — Classify up to 25 texts in one call (support tickets, leads, reviews, emails, intents). texts = items separated by | or newlines, or a JSON array (each up to 1,000 chars). labels = comma-separated allowed labels (optional; without it the model invents up to 8 reusable categories). Optional multi=true (1-3 labels each) and context= (what the texts are). Labels are snapped offline to your allowed set, off-list answers are dropped and counted, and you get per-item label, confidence and reason, a label distribution, and a CLEAN / MOSTLY_CLEAN / REVIEW verdict. Workers AI llama-3.3-70b. Price: $0.012 USDC (Base, via x402).

texts.description: e.g. My card was charged twice this month|How do I reset my password?|The new dashboard is great

name: ai_classify_batch
